description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. has been placed on the physically unable to perform (PUP) list by the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: This comes as a bit of a surprise, as Porter was not one of the players that Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy listed with an injury earlier on Tuesday. More details and a potential timetable for return for Porter's injury will likely be made clear in the coming days.
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. placed on PUP list

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: The Philadelphia Eagles are signing Jalen Carter to a 4-year, $152 million extension.
items.impact: Carter's extension makes him the highest-paid defensive tackle in NFL history, and he will now be under contract with the Eagles through the 2031 season. The 25-year-old has made the Pro Bowl in two of his three seasons and has developed into one of the best interior linemen in the league.
items.title: Jalen Carter signs 4-year extension with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers told reporters "zero debate" this is his last year.
items.impact: Rodgers made the same statement back in May. This will be the last ride for him after a long, historic career as he plays one more season with Mike McCarthy.
items.title: Aaron Rodgers says 'zero debate' this will be his final season

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Mitchell Evans rolled his ankle during practice on Tuesday and the trainers are optimistic.
items.impact: Evans appears to have avoided a scare after he was carted off the field from practice on Tuesday. He'll likely miss some time, but it appears it may not miss too much time during training camp.
items.title: Mitchell Evans rolls ankle, trainers optimistic

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bucs beat reporter Greg Auman says Baker Mayfield will play the 2026 season on his current expiring deal.
items.impact: The talks of a new contract for Mayfield and the Bucs are finished for now. This is a bit of a surprise with still over a month to go till the start of the season. The Bucs will have the option to exercise the franchise tag on Mayfield for the 2027 season.
items.title: Baker Mayfield expected to play this season without new deal

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colts GM Chris Ballard said Alec Pierce is a week or two away from returning.
items.impact: Pierce opened training camp on the PUP list. He'll likely be activated at some point in early-to-mid August.
items.title: Alec Pierce (ankle) week or two away from returning

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said De'Von Achane is ready to go after offseason shoulder surgery.
items.impact: Achane didn't participate in team drills this spring as he rehabbed, but he's good to go now that training camp's here. He'll be in line for his workhorse role as the focal point of the Dolphins offense.
items.title: De'Von Achane (shoulder) cleared to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colts GM Chris Ballard said Anthony Richardson Sr trade request still in place.
items.impact: "Not going to give him away," Ballard said. This will remain a situation to monitor into the season.
items.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. trade request still in place

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Mason Rudolph will start off taking reps with the second-team.
items.impact: Will Howard and Drew Allar will split the reps with the No. 3 team. They'll likely all continue to compete throughout training camp and into the preseason.
items.title: Mason Rudolph to start off training camp taking second-team reps

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said rookie WR Chris Bell is not very far away from returning.
items.impact: Bell opened training camp on the non-football injury list. Bell did the Dolphins conditioning test and will be running around at the start of camp.
items.title: Chris Bell not far away from returning

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Robert Hunt is still not practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hunt continues to deal with a back injury that has sidelined him since the weekend. He remains day-to-day.
items.title: Robert Hunt (back) not practicing Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Jackson Sr. is back in pads at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Jackson missed a few days of practice due to a back injury. He was back on the field on Tuesday.
items.title: Mike Jackson Sr. (back) returns to practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers GM Omar Khan announced that Broderick Jones has improved rapidly and he has been cleared to practice
items.impact: Jones will not start training camp on the PUP list. The Steelers are still evaluating Jones from a strength perspective, but he has been fully cleared to practice.
items.title: Broderick Jones (neck) cleared to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chris Brazzell II is still not practicing on Tuesday with knee soreness.
items.impact: The Panthers won't be rushing Brazzell back. He is competing for an immediate role on the outside for Carolina.
items.title: Chris Brazzell II (knee) not practicing Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers placed CB Donte Kent on the PUP list.
items.impact: Kent won't be ready to go to begin training camp. He can be activated at any time.
items.title: Donte Kent placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers placed CB Jalen Ramsey on the PUP list.
items.impact: Ramsey is not ready to go to begin training camp. He can be activated at any time.
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (knee) placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings signed RB Jordan Mims.
items.impact: Mims was waived by the 49ers. He will compete for a depth role in the Vikings backfield.
items.title: Jordan Mims signs with Vikings

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: DeForest Buckner has passed his physical and will practice with the Colts in training camp despite fears he may miss some time. It is worth noting, however, that the team will be taking it easy on him with a ramp up process.
items.impact: This is great news for a Colts team that is looking to build off their newfound success in 2025. Buckner should help anchor their defensive front and will look to rebound after coming off of an injury shortened season.
items.title: DeForest Buckner (neck) passes physical and will practice

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jaycee Horn (foot) has been cleared to practice and activated off of the NFI list after suffering a foot laceration.
items.impact: Horn will now get back up to speed and get to work as the Panthers' top corner in 2026. He's looking to build off of a 2025 season that saw him rack up a career high five interceptions.
items.title: Jaycee Horn (foot) activated off of NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings signed Jamal Adams.
items.impact: Adams has struggled to stay healthy in recent years. He lands a fresh start in Minnesota under Brian Flores.
items.title: Jamal Adams signs with Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks plan to waive RB Kenny McIntosh.
items.impact: McIntosh began training camp on PUP while recovering from a torn ACL he suffered last summer. He has struggled with injuries since being drafted in 2023.
items.title: Kenny McIntosh to be waived by Seahawks

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Vita Vea has requested a trade from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Vea was a minicamp hold-in and is entering the final year of his contract, in which he is owed $17 million. The defensive tackle requesting a trade does not guarantee he will be on a new team by Week 1, but this is definitely a situation to monitor as training camp kicks off around the league this week.
items.title: Vita Vea requests trade from Buccaneers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins released DL Kahlil Saunders.
items.impact: Saunders will figure to seek another opportunity entering training camp.
items.title: Kahlil Saunders released by Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Miami Dolphins have signed EDGE Clelin Ferrell.
items.impact: Ferrell is a former No. 4 overall pick of the Raiders. He'll add depth for the pass rush of Miami.
items.title: Clelin Ferrell signs with Dolphins

title: Fantasy Player News
